name: diagnostics_channel
notes: Provides the low-overhead named in-process channels used by Undici. Named channels preserve identity, `hasSubscribers` avoids publish work when no listener is installed, and publishing calls subscribers synchronously. The experimental tracing and AsyncLocalStorage store APIs remain explicit unavailable contract members.

apis.name: channel(name), hasSubscribers(name), subscribe(name, onMessage), and unsubscribe(name, onMessage)
apis.notes: Supports string and symbol names, module-level and channel-instance subscription management, reusable channel identity, and listener snapshotting during synchronous publish.

apis.name: Channel.publish(message)
apis.notes: Calls the subscriber snapshot with `(message, channelName)` synchronously; the no-subscriber path performs no callback or snapshot allocation.

apis.name: tracingChannel(), TracingChannel, bindStore(), unbindStore(), and runStores()
apis.notes: These Node 24 APIs remain present in the complete generated contract and fail explicitly.
